modifications: NauctionsCrafting.lua adds local known-recipe profit ranking, readiness checks, and recipe cost tooltips without exporting character state.
AuctionDB.toc names the fork and declares the shared profession global.
AuctionDB.lua enables full-scan retention by default for new installations.
Minimap.lua and the TOC use a built-in game icon. Upstream binary icon assets are not bundled.
NauctionsAuctionRecipes.lua adds auction browse, item-search, and full-scan recipe discovery with persistent unresolved items.
Record.lua leaves missing auction links unresolved and preserves the expected scan count.
Scan.lua retains the API row count when replicate rows are unavailable.
NauctionsBeta.lua bundles attributed Normal Horde beta reference data. NauctionsForecasts.lua shows separate beta scenarios and expiring offline live-forecast caches.
licenceNote: The upstream repository LICENSE is preserved. Source headers and TOC identify LGPLv3; those notices are preserved. See LICENSE and source notices.
